parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "model": "llama-3.1-8b-instant",
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "system",
      "content": "You are an AI Startup Idea Analyzer. Always return ONLY valid JSON. Never use markdown, code fences, explanations, comments, or additional text. Follow the JSON schema exactly. Never interchange generated_title and generated_description."
    },
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": "Analyze the following startup idea and generate startup metadata.

Return ONLY this JSON structure:

{
  "input_hash": "",
  "generated_description": "",
  "generated_title": "",
  "industry": "",
  "matching_score": 0,
  "is_reanalysis": false,
  "reanalysis_count": 0,
  "analysis_status": "Completed",
  "ai_model": "llama-3.1-8b-instant",
  "confidence_score": 0,
  "updated_at": ""
}

Rules:
- generated_title MUST be ONLY a startup/product/business name.
- generated_title MUST NOT be a sentence.
- generated_title MUST NOT describe the startup.
- generated_title MUST contain a maximum of 8 words.
- Example generated_title: "Startup Idea Analyzer", "HealthSync AI", "MarketPulse", "Smart Finance Assistant".

- generated_description MUST be ONLY the business description.
- generated_description MUST be 40-80 words.
- generated_description MUST explain what the startup does, who it serves, and its business value.
- generated_description MUST NOT be a title.
- generated_description MUST NOT repeat the title.

- industry: Return only one industry.
- matching_score: Integer between 70 and 100.
- confidence_score: Integer between 75 and 100.
- analysis_status: Always 'Completed'.
- is_reanalysis: Always false.
- reanalysis_count: Always 0.
- input_hash: Return an empty string.
- updated_at: Return the current UTC timestamp in ISO-8601 format.
- ai_model: Always return 'llama-3.1-8b-instant'.

IMPORTANT:
Never interchange generated_title and generated_description.
Return ONLY the JSON object without any additional text.

Startup Idea:
{{$json.description}}"
    }
  ],
  "temperature": 0.3
}
